org.name: Hartwell Labs
org.description: Independent open-source lab building security-adjacent developer tools.

products.name: talus
products.tagline: eBPF ransomware detection with auto-kill for Linux
products.description: Endpoint detection & response agent for Linux, written in Rust. eBPF tracepoints (execve/openat/unlink/mkdir) score a 1-second sliding window per process and SIGKILL threats automatically. Single static binary, no kernel module, no signatures. The agent sandboxes itself (CAP_BPF|CAP_PERFMON|CAP_NET_ADMIN, seccomp + Landlock).

products.name: externum
products.tagline: A typed language that compiles to Python, Bash and native bytecode
products.description: Self-hosted programming language: Python-style readability with enforced type declarations, inline Bash for system control, and compilation to a standalone .exbc bytecode artifact. Struct/enum/trait/impl, match-case, defer, string interpolation, TUI IDE, REPL, browser playground, built-in DRM/licensing stack. NEW in 4.3: externum translate — import existing Python (AST-based) and Rust (heuristic) code. 400+ tests in CI.

products.name: Aurora OS
products.tagline: A complete operating system running in your browser
products.description: From-scratch desktop environment running entirely client-side: kernel with typed EventBus and process table, window manager (drag, 8-handle resize), POSIX-inspired virtual filesystem, terminal with 36+ commands, 14 apps (Files, Editor, Paint, System Monitor, Minesweeper…), full-system snapshots (.aurora v2, SHA-256), 5 themes + animated wallpapers, procedural WebAudio. Zero runtime dependencies.

products.name: Hack the Lab
products.tagline: Attack our open-source products — get CVEs and a Hall of Fame entry
products.description: Hartwell Labs publicly exposes its own tools: escape the browser-OS VFS, break the language sandbox, evade the eBPF ransomware detector. Concrete challenges instead of a vague security.txt. Safe harbor, coordinated disclosure, <48h response time. CVEs where warranted, public Hall of Fame.
